title: FOLD BOD Model: Python code for the Fractional-Order Logistic Decay model of biochemical oxygen demand
description: Python implementation of the Fractional-Order Logistic Decay (FOLD) model for biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), introduced in Devassy (2026), Water and Environment Journal, https://doi.org/10.1111/wej.70098. Fits FOLD and the classical first-order model to any BOD time series, reports R2, RMSE, AIC and BIC, flags parameters at fitting limits, and computes activated-sludge and aerated-lagoon retention time, volume and blower power. Includes an example dataset, tests and a command-line tool.
